differences.a_observable: The background card 'Revenue Analytics' is heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background card 'Revenue Analytics' is sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to blur the background.

differences.a_observable: The white cards have a cool, blue-tinted color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white cards are neutral white/grey with no blue tint.
differences.fix: Apply a cool color grade or adjust the light colors to introduce a blue cast.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center due to a vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame have similar brightness to the center.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The blue card has a glossy finish with subtle specular reflections along its rounded edges.
differences.b_observable: The blue card has a flat, matte finish with no specular highlights on the edges.
differences.fix: Adjust the material roughness and specular settings of the blue card to create glossy edge highlights.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to match the shallow focus of the reference, particularly in the second shot after the cut.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the grid, showing the yellow card with a strong perspective tilt.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away, showing the yellow card with a flatter perspective.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and field of view.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles have a soft blue-grey tint.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles are neutral white and grey.
differences.fix: Adjust background material color and lighting color temperature.

differences.a_observable: The frame of the Juspay card has a brushed metallic texture.
differences.b_observable: The frame of the Juspay card is flat grey plastic.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal material to the card frame.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera position and field of view to match the dynamic perspective of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette darkens the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: Corners are bright with no visible vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to darken the corners.

differences.a_observable: White tiles have a cool blue color cast.
differences.b_observable: White tiles are warm gray with no blue cast.

differences.a_observable: Shadows are deeper and contrast is higher.
differences.b_observable: Shadows are washed out and contrast is lower.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Add a cool blue color cast and deepen the shadows to match the reference lighting.
